messages.text: How do changes in automotive radar technology affect the measurement capability required from Vector Network Analyzer?

The supported effect is on AREG800A automotive-radar echo-generator measurements, where the VNA must handle specified IF-transfer and ghost-object-suppression measurements with defined time-domain, bandwidth, step-size, source-power, and span settings [24][25].
R&S AREG800A is an Automotive Radar Echo Generator used for dynamic artificial object generation [31].
Its echo generation can be hybrid, using an analog stepped delay line for short object distances below 17 m and fully digital implementation for longer distances up to 3000 m [58].
Its digital echo generation is used for FMCW radar, with maximum generated distance of 3000 m [58].
AREG800A production configurations include one, two, or three digital channels, and the radar mini configuration includes 5 GHz instantaneous bandwidth [26].
The radar pro configuration supports monostatic or bistatic frontend operation and three digital channels [26].
For AREG800A IF transfer characteristics, the VNA measurement condition is frequency step size 2.5 MHz, measurement bandwidth 1 kHz, source power –10 dBm, and spans of 1.1 GHz to 2.1 GHz, 0.7 GHz to 2.7 GHz, or 0.7 GHz to 5.7 GHz depending on bandwidth [25].
For suppression of ghost objects, the measurement condition is a vector network analyzer in time domain, frequency step size 125 kHz, measurement bandwidth 100 kHz, source power –10 dBm, 2 m distance to the wanted artificial object, and spans of 1.1 GHz to 2.1 GHz, 0.7 GHz to 2.7 GHz, or 0.7 GHz to 5.7 GHz depending on bandwidth [24].
AREG800A dynamic RCS range is 90 dB for all artificial objects on one IF path with R&S AREG8-24S/24D/81S/81D, and 60 dB for multiple objects per IF path with those options [25].
RCS control step size is 0.1 dB [25].
R&S ZNA base units provide measurement bandwidth from 1 Hz to 1.5 MHz, and with R&S ZNA-K17 increased IF bandwidth option from 1 Hz to 30 MHz [36].
R&S ZNA software options include R&S ZNA-K2 time domain analysis and R&S ZNA-K20 extended time domain analysis including eye diagram [37].
R&S ZNA software options also include R&S ZNA-K8 mmWave converter support [37].
R&S ZNA67EXT is a 1.0 mm vector network analyzer system covering 10 MHz to 110 GHz [2].
【推論】For automotive-radar echo-generator setups using 5 GHz instantaneous bandwidth and VNA spans up to 0.7 GHz to 5.7 GHz, the VNA measurement capability must cover multi-GHz IF sweeps with the stated 2.5 MHz or 125 kHz frequency steps, 1 kHz or 100 kHz measurement bandwidth, and –10 dBm source power [24][25][26].
【推論】Because ghost-object suppression is measured by a vector network analyzer in time domain, automotive-radar validation involving ghost objects requires VNA time-domain capability such as the R&S ZNA-K2 time domain analysis option [24][37].
【推論】Because the base R&S ZNA series covers up to 67 GHz while R&S ZNA67EXT covers up to 110 GHz, measurements above 67 GHz would require the 110 GHz ZNA67EXT-type capability rather than only the base ZNA67 capability [2][33].

- [[MIMO]] 被定義為：many antennas at the transceiver to increase capacity。
- [[Massive MIMO]] 被定義為：very high number of antenna elements at the transceiver，並且是 beamforming and spatial multiplexing 的 combination。
- 來源說 increasing demand for higher MIMO degree，且有 mid-band spectrum 的 operators 對 Massive MIMO 更有信心，例子包括 China、US。
- 來源說 [[Beamforming]] 是提升 system efficiency 的 essential measure，尤其是 mmWave。

- 來源另列 beamforming components & accuracy verification：fully integrated solution、no calibration needed、simultaneous measurement on ≤24 ports within one instrument、verify beamformer ICs for phased array antennas、2D/3D beamforming / beam-steering verification。

The supported effect is on AREG800A automotive-radar echo-generator measurements, where the VNA must handle specified IF-transfer and ghost-object-suppression measurements with defined time-domain, bandwidth, step-size, source-power, and span settings [24][25].
R&S AREG800A is an Automotive Radar Echo Generator used for dynamic artificial object generation [31].
Its echo generation can be hybrid, using an analog stepped delay line for short object distances below 17 m and fully digital implementation for longer distances up to 3000 m [58].
Its digital echo generation is used for FMCW radar, with maximum generated distance of 3000 m [58].
AREG800A production configurations include one, two, or three digital channels, and the radar mini configuration includes 5 GHz instantaneous bandwidth [26].
The radar pro configuration supports monostatic or bistatic frontend operation and three digital channels [26].
For AREG800A IF transfer characteristics, the VNA measurement condition is frequency step size 2.5 MHz, measurement bandwidth 1 kHz, source power –10 dBm, and spans of 1.1 GHz to 2.1 GHz, 0.7 GHz to 2.7 GHz, or 0.7 GHz to 5.7 GHz depending on bandwidth [25].
For suppression of ghost objects, the measurement condition is a vector network analyzer in time domain, frequency step size 125 kHz, measurement bandwidth 100 kHz, source power –10 dBm, 2 m distance to the wanted artificial object, and spans of 1.1 GHz to 2.1 GHz, 0.7 GHz to 2.7 GHz, or 0.7 GHz to 5.7 GHz depending on bandwidth [24].
AREG800A dynamic RCS range is 90 dB for all artificial objects on one IF path with R&S AREG8-24S/24D/81S/81D, and 60 dB for multiple objects per IF path with those options [25].
RCS control step size is 0.1 dB [25].
R&S ZNA base units provide measurement bandwidth from 1 Hz to 1.5 MHz, and with R&S ZNA-K17 increased IF bandwidth option from 1 Hz to 30 MHz [36].
R&S ZNA software options include R&S ZNA-K2 time domain analysis and R&S ZNA-K20 extended time domain analysis including eye diagram [37].
R&S ZNA software options also include R&S ZNA-K8 mmWave converter support [37].
R&S ZNA67EXT is a 1.0 mm vector network analyzer system covering 10 MHz to 110 GHz [2].
【推論】For automotive-radar echo-generator setups using 5 GHz instantaneous bandwidth and VNA spans up to 0.7 GHz to 5.7 GHz, the VNA measurement capability must cover multi-GHz IF sweeps with the stated 2.5 MHz or 125 kHz frequency steps, 1 kHz or 100 kHz measurement bandwidth, and –10 dBm source power [24][25][26].
【推論】Because ghost-object suppression is measured by a vector network analyzer in time domain, automotive-radar validation involving ghost objects requires VNA time-domain capability such as the R&S ZNA-K2 time domain analysis option [24][37].
【推論】Because the base R&S ZNA series covers up to 67 GHz while R&S ZNA67EXT covers up to 110 GHz, measurements above 67 GHz would require the 110 GHz ZNA67EXT-type capability rather than only the base ZNA67 capability [2][33].
